sections.title: Local Data
sections.text: BlinkenBadge stores your working project and display preferences on your device. It does not require an account or send projects, imported images, or badge identifiers to developer-operated servers.

sections.title: Bluetooth
sections.text: Bluetooth access finds nearby compatible badges and sends artwork to the badge you select. On Android 7 through 11, the operating system also requires location permission for Bluetooth discovery. BlinkenBadge does not use this permission to track your location.

sections.title: Files
sections.text: BlinkenBadge reads the projects and images you select with the system picker. Export writes a copy to the destination you choose. Cloud storage providers handle exported files under their own privacy policies.

sections.title: Tracking
sections.text: BlinkenBadge includes no advertising, analytics, or tracking services. Apple and Google may provide platform diagnostics and beta-testing feedback under their own policies and your device settings.

sections.title: Retention
sections.text: Your working project remains on the device until you replace it or remove the app's local data. Exported copies remain in the destination you selected until you delete them there.
